title: sciglyph: publication figures as code
description: Publication-quality scientific illustration in pure matplotlib. Draws CONSORT participant-flow diagrams with the counts reconciled before anything is rendered, and provides schematic glyphs for overview figures and architecture diagrams, so a figure regenerates when the numbers change instead of going silently stale.
